reviewMode: read-only native-pixel geometry review with a single text report output

coordinateConvention.boxes: [left,top,right,bottom), integer half-open; bounded visual evidence regions, not segmentation masks

scope.assigned: First two horizontal boundaries, first two native rows of vertical boundaries, and all nine four-patch intersections; focused row-three vertical extensions for the reported structural defects.
scope.note: The nine intersection crops cover local portions of the seven unreviewed strips, not their full lengths. No assertion of all-24 pair-strip coverage is made.

acceptance.note: Parent reported local repair work in qa/finish-20261011 while this baseline review was in progress. This file preserves baseline observations and does not accept or reject those later repair pixels.

findingsP2.title: Diamond frame upper-left diagonal is displaced at two core boundaries
findingsP2.observation: The gold outer strip and red inner bevel have a visible step rather than a continuous straight diagonal. At y2048 a short horizontal splice cuts the ascending left gold edge. This is geometric, not a color-only transition.
findingsP2.suggestedLocalTreatment: Reconstruct one consistent diagonal across both boundaries within a shared native-pixel repair window, retaining the diamond apex, existing frame thickness and relief.

findingsP2.title: Circular tile end and red fascia step at x3072
findingsP2.observation: A circular decorated cap is cut at the vertical splice and replaced on the right by a plain oval tile end. Both red fascia edges jump in height at the same x coordinate.
findingsP2.suggestedLocalTreatment: Use one shared local solution for the final cap, the tile-end rhythm and both red fascia edges; preserve the existing roof slope.

findingsP2.title: Orphan half gold ornament clipped at x2048
findingsP2.observation: A gold crescent has a perfectly vertical missing left half coincident with the splice. It does not join the gold ridge and reads as a residual fragment on a blue tile.
findingsP2.suggestedLocalTreatment: Remove only the isolated crescent and continue the underlying blue-tile surface and highlight. Keep the large gold ridge and its end scroll unchanged.

findingsP2.title: Gray masonry band interrupts the upper gold pipe at x3072
findingsP2.observation: The gold pipe visible in the left native overlap is covered in p14 by a gray stone band whose lower edge stops horizontally at native y229. The assembled pipe/masonry boundary changes abruptly at x3072; this is an occlusion/shape disagreement.
findingsP2.suggestedLocalTreatment: Resolve the pipe and stone boundary in one local window using the existing north context. Preserve the existing large diagonal ridge and its elbow.

findingsP3.title: Roof sharpness and material change near first junction
findingsP3.observation: Above y1024 the left blue roofing is softer; below it the surface and highlights are sharper. There is minor tone/relief mismatch where a cap crosses x1024. Main roof, ridge and eave outlines still connect.
findingsP3.treatment: Optional material-only cleanup; do not move roof geometry.

findingsP3.title: Subtle red window-header tone difference
findingsP3.observation: The red header shows a small vertical material/tone change at x3072. Frame and gold-lattice contours remain continuous.
findingsP3.treatment: Optional restricted material correction; no geometry repair required.
